cues.text: Hurry up, Teddy! The train is leaving in two minutes!
Relax! My shoe lace was untied.
Look at the clock! It's moving too fast!
Impossible. Clocks don't have legs.
It literally just winked at us!
Let's ask the station master over there.
Excuse us! When does this train depart?
Right now! And you missed it by ten seconds!
No way! We have our tickets right here!
Tickets don't matter if the train is already flying!
Flying?! Since when do trains fly?!
Well, that's great. Now we're stuck at the station.
We cannot just sit here! We have a journey to finish!
Let's make tea using the station khokha!
Hey! That's my private stove!
Sorry, mister! We are just desperate travelers!
Ah, this tea is actually quite good.
Stop drinking and help me push this crate!
Push it where? The tracks are empty!
Wait… where did the train go?
It left for the mountains an hour ago!
An hour ago?! But you said ten seconds!
Time flies when you're having fun at the station!
This isn't fun, this is a nightmare!
Look, a stray dog is sleeping on the platform!
What does a sleeping dog have to do with our train?
Maybe he knows the shortcut through the hills!
Woof! Follow me, you fools!
Did that dog just speak English?!
Who cares! Run after the dog!
I'm too out of shape for this adventure!
I can see the whole village from up here!
Get down before you fall off that tank!
Whoops! I'm slipping on the metal!
I got you! Grab my hand!
Safe! Thanks for not letting me crash.
Here, take this mango and stop making noise.
Mmm, surprisingly delicious! Free food is the best.
Wait, listen… do you hear that sound?
It's the train coming back!
Quick, grab our bags!
Open the coach door, it's stopping!
Toot toot! All aboard the express!
We made it! Inside the train at last!
Never running for a train ever again.
Until the next episode, anyway!
Don't leave me behind, guys!
Oh look, our favorite dog wants to come too!
Quick, pull him inside the window!
Thanks, humans! This train is awesome!
Best railway station trip ever!
